set.body:
Goal: let layers over different row types coexist in one plot (e.g. a data layer plus an annotation layer with a different shape), without encoding hacks.

Evidence: Plot[Row] fixes one row type for every layer (Grammar.scala:223-227); Layer[Row] shares the same Row (Grammar.scala:161-167) — per-layer data is allowed but must be the same type.

Acceptance: an existential/wrapped layer (each layer packages its own Row type with its mapping and scale bindings) so the plot holds heterogeneous layers; the compiler resolves each layer against its own rows while scales still train plot-wide (coordinate with the plot-global scale issue); invalid combinations stay typed errors; conformance gains a mixed-data case; JVM+JS tests.
set.title: Graphics: heterogeneous layer data (existentially-typed layers)
